issues.explanation: Change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests for the new actions, policy, factory, or call-path authorization despite conventions requiring tests including unauthorized-call coverage.
Identical isUniqueViolation helper is copy-pasted in both queue actions instead of a shared helper.
Factory afterMaking has convoluted branches with unreachable null checks, making the same-entity default guarantee hard to verify.
Name length uses strlen so multibyte names are measured in bytes rather than chars against the 1-255 rule.
Slug from Str::slug can be empty for punctuation-only input with no empty-slug validation.
Call permission is checked via hardcoded 'call' string instead of the QueuePermission::Call value.
Schema diff truncates after the ER Diagram header so full queue_access documentation is unverifiable, and business-rules retains stale entity-membership wording.
Returns $queue->fresh() without a null check so a concurrent delete would violate the Queue return type.

conventions.evidence: Actions in app/Actions/* authorize via Gate (CreateQueue:60, UpdateQueue:214, SetQueueAccess:131), policy in app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:399, reversible migration with down() (:590-593), #[Fillable] matching Ticket (:311), Log::channel('audit') (:161,:181); deviation: zero test files in 13-file diff (grep Test.php/tests/Pest hits only CHANGELOG CI line) violating test-first / everything-ships-with-test.

readability.evidence: Actions/policy small with clear names (CreateQueue:58, UpdateQueue:207, SetQueueAccess:129, QueuePolicy:430); factory :509-554 nested branches with dead code hard to follow; business-rules:604 retains stale '(entity-membership checked...)' alongside new policy sentence.

requirements.evidence: CreateQueue:60-93 trim/1-255, Str::slug default/explicit, unique-within-entity check :72-76 plus race-to-ValidationException :85-90, is_active=true; UpdateQueue:207-266 nullable name/slug/isActive with whereKeyNot own slug :233-237 plus race mapping :255-260; SetQueueAccess:129-186 same-entity check, allowlist validation, empty-revokes/non-empty-upserts, audit granted/revoked with actor_id/queue_id/entity_membership_id and no log when no row; QueuePolicy:412-462 create/update/manageAccess/call incl non-array denies; CallNextTicket:31-34 and Ticket:375-390 enforce inactive-then-auth-then-waiting order; model/factory/enum/migration/contracts match task.

scope.evidence: 13 diffs all serve the task (actions/enum/model/factory/migration/policy/call-path enforcement/docs+changelog); no delete/remove/destroy queue action added per task section 4; no UI or plan-limit extras.

security.evidence: Gate authorize before writes (CreateQueue:60, UpdateQueue:214, SetQueueAccess:131); call enforced post-lock post-active in CallNextTicket:31-34 and Ticket:383-385 with AuthorizationException before LogicException; SetQueueAccess validates entity match :133 and permission allowlist :144-150 before writes; policy denies non-members/non-employees and corrupted perms :434-462; Fillable allowlist :311; no Livewire/Blade surface.

simplicity.evidence: Duplicate isUniqueViolation in CreateQueue:96-106 and UpdateQueue:269-279; QueueAccessFactory:507-555 triple-branch afterMaking with unreachable blocks :531-535 (queue_id===null inside !==null branch) and :548-552; hardcoded 'call' in QueuePolicy:461 instead of QueuePermission::Call->value.

tests.evidence: grep change.diff for Test.php|tests/|Pest hits only the CHANGELOG CI line; the 13-file diff contains no tests/ file, so no happy-path, validation-failure, or unauthorized-call coverage for Create/Update/SetAccess or the call paths.

review.summary: The change implements the queue lifecycle, per-queue call grants, policy, and both call-path enforcement with correct ordering and audit logging. It ships with no tests despite the project's test-first gate, plus a duplicated unique-violation helper and an over-complex factory, so it needs changes (notably tests) before merging.
